summary: Independent second-pass review confirms both findings are corrected. MVP-CRIT-001: the exact Project Chat host is permitted globally, for Stop/reconciliation/panel tasks and for bounded repairs, with matching specifications and explicit exclusion of the separate IDE surface. MVP-CRIT-002: all 11 normative documents are SHA256-bound within canonical contract requirements; every binding matches current bytes, and mismatch explicitly blocks execution pending revision, critique and owner approval. Schema validation and canonical material digest verification passed; all 23 manifest entries match their recorded hashes and sizes. Comparison against the first-round contract found only the stated corrections, with dependency order, conservative cancellation/recovery behavior, quality gates and feature-only delivery unchanged. Approval covers this planning proposal only: owner execution approval, scoped Beads readiness reconciliation and document-hash preflight remain required. No runtime implementation or enforcement capability was verified.
